What we build

Not just bathrooms — every room.

Floors, showers, fireplaces, and outdoor spaces. Every job is measured, waterproofed where it counts, and set by the same crew from start to grout. No subcontracted tile work.

01

Bathroom Remodels

Gut renovations and layout changes — new plumbing rough-in, fixtures, and finishes, start to finish.

02

Floors & Large-Format Tile

Marble, porcelain, and plank flooring set throughout living rooms, kitchens, and hallways — leveled tight, edge to edge.

03

Fireplaces & Stonework

Stacked stone veneer, custom mantles, and indoor or outdoor fireplace rebuilds from the studs up.

04

Outdoor Living

Patios, pool decks, and outdoor kitchens tiled in large-format stone built to handle the weather.

How a job runs

Four steps, no surprises.

01

Walkthrough & quote

We measure the space, talk through what you want, and give you a clear, itemized quote before anything starts.

02

Demo

Old fixtures, tile, and tub come out. If the layout's changing, plumbing gets reworked here too.

03

Build

Waterproofing, tile setting, and fixture installation — done in sequence, no shortcuts on cure times.

04

Walkthrough & handoff

We go over every line and seam with you in person before the job is marked complete.

Get started

Ready to get your space done right?

Bathroom, kitchen, floors, fireplace, or patio — send a few photos of the space and what you're picturing, and we'll follow up with next steps and a quote.
